data.narrative:
Fuse Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company currently valued at $200M+ post-money, having raised $78M to date. The broader nuclear energy sector comprises 3 public comparables (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, General Matter, and Standard Nuclear.

Given the fragmented state of nuclear energy valuations and early-stage dynamics, only one triangulation method proved reliable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x multiplier to the last post-money valuation of $200M, yielding an implied valuation of $400M. This reflects typical step-up dynamics from Series A to subsequent rounds. Peer-median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables in the narrow nuclear subsector; only three same-sector peers exist in total, insufficient for a robust median benchmark.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, with a median point of $400M. This range reflects the stage-progression method anchored to documented post-money data. Key uncertainties include the limited peer set available for cross-validation, the early maturity of commercial nuclear platforms generally, and lack of revenue visibility typical at Series A in capital-intensive infrastructure sectors. Any refinement would require either additional same-stage nuclear peers or forward financials demonstrating pathway to revenue.
